description: This file contains extension methods for the IAsyncObservable<T> interface in the Orleans.Streams namespace. It provides various overloads of SubscribeAsync methods that allow subscribing to observables using delegate handlers with different combinations of parameters such as onNext, onError, onCompleted, and stream sequence tokens.

classes.name: AsyncObservableExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IAsyncObservable<T> to facilitate subscribing with delegate handlers.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Multiple overloads for subscribing to an IAsyncObservable<T> with delegate handlers for onNext, onError, onCompleted, and stream sequence tokens, returning a Task representing the subscription handle.
